question: Eight people E, F, G, H, J, K, L and M are sitting around a circular table facing the centre but not necessarily in the same order. F is sitting second to the left of K. H is an immediate neighbour of K. There are only three people sitting between H and E. Only one person sits between L and E. M is sitting to the immediate right of the L. G is to the immediate left of F. What is the position of L with respect to H?
